Entries.MixedFlowerSeeds_Description: Turli gul urug‘lari to‘plami. Ekib, nima o‘sishini ko‘ring!
Entries.MixedSeeds_Description: Bu yerda har narsadan ozgina bor. Ekib, nima o‘sishini ko‘ring!
Entries.MonsterMusk_Description: Yashirinib yotgan ko‘proq mahluqlarni jalb qilish uchun buni ustingizga seping.
Entries.Morel_Description: O‘ziga xos yong‘oqsimon ta’mi uchun qadrlanadi.
Entries.Moss_Description: Soya joylarda o‘sadigan o‘simlikning o‘ziga xos turi.
Entries.MossSoup_Description: Quyuq va shilimshiq, ammo yeyish mumkin.
Entries.MossySeed_Description: Noyob yovvoyi daraxtlar o‘stirish uchun buni ekish mumkin.
Entries.MovieTicket_Description: Bir kishini kinoteatrga kiritadi. Buni do‘stingizga bersangiz, uni siz bilan kinoga taklif qilasiz.
Entries.MsAngler_Description: O‘ljani jalb qilish uchun nur sochib osilib turuvchi o‘ljadan foydalanadi.
Entries.Mudstone_Description: Qadimiy gil yoki loydan hosil bo‘lgan mayda donali tog‘ jinsi.
Entries.MummifiedFrog_Description: Bu qadimiy qurbaqa changalzorning yuqori qavatida yashagan bo‘lishi mumkin.
Entries.MuscleRemedy_Description: Tanangizni haddan tashqari zo‘riqtirganingizda, «Holsizlik»ni yo‘qotish uchun buni iching.
Entries.MushroomTreeSeed_Description: Qo‘ziqorin daraxti ekish uchun buni fermangizga joylashtiring.
Entries.Mussel_Description: Ko‘pincha to‘p bo‘lib yashaydigan keng tarqalgan ikki pallali mollyuska.
Entries.MutantCarp_Description: Kanalizatsiyaning g‘alati suvlari bu karpni mahluqqa aylantirgan.
Entries.MysteryBox_Description: Buni siz uchun temirchi ochib bera oladi. Ichida nima borligini kim bilsin?
Entries.MysticStone_Description: Tosh, ruda yoki geodalar olish uchun parchalab tashlang.
Entries.MysticSyrup_Description: Sehrli xususiyatlarga ega, deb aytiladigan juda noyob qiyom.
Entries.MysticTreeSeed_Description: O‘ziga xos daraxt o‘stirish uchun buni ekish mumkin.
Entries.NautilusFossil_Description: U qadimiy marjon rifidan juda ko‘p asrlar avval qirg‘oqqa oqib kelgan bo‘lsa kerak.
Entries.Nekoite_Description: Nozik siniqlar mitti pushti o‘tloqni eslatuvchi shakl hosil qiladi.
Entries.Neptunite_Description: G‘ayrioddiy darajada aks ettiruvchi qop-qora kristall.
Entries.OakResin_Description: Eman shirasidan olinadigan yopishqoq, xushbo‘y modda.
Entries.Obsidian_Description: Lava tez soviganda hosil bo‘ladigan vulqon shishasi.
